subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support a public `AgentToolResult.control` yield contract for external plugin tools?
rationale: The patch is additive and well-tested, but only a maintainer can accept the long-term compatibility and ownership commitment of a new public Plugin SDK runtime-control surface.

options.title: Adopt the public yield contract
options.body: Accept the narrow yield-only result control, rebase the PR, and land it after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Retain the runtime mechanism but remove or mark the external Plugin SDK helper experimental until the contract is finalized.

options.title: Pause this direction
options.body: Close or hold the PR and continue design discussion in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/109761 without publishing the API.

recommendation.title: Adopt the public yield contract
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow yield-only result control, rebase the PR, and land it after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal spans the embedded agent runtime, capability boundaries, and public product surface decisions.
